notes: FORM IDENTITY - this is NOT the 2022+ county-offices instrument. Every page is scanned SIDEWAYS (rotated 90 degrees) at low contrast, and the printed title reads 'Candidate Financial Disclosure / Financial Campaign Report for SCHOOL BOARD' beside the Cache County CLERK/AUDITOR seal. It is structurally the same four-part instrument as the county form (p1 cover, p2 Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received, p3 Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made, p4 Summary Page with boxes A-F plus 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period'), but its cover offers FOUR report-type choices (30 days after withdrawal or elimination / Seven days preceding the Primary Election / 30 Days after the Primary Election / Seven days preceding the General Election / 30 Days after the General Election) and its Summary Page uses lower-case box labels ('Contributions Received this Period'). Because its printed title is neither the county-offices form nor the Carr 20A-11-1301 school-board instrument, form_read is 'other'. NO statutory citation is printed on any page. IT DOES CARRY A SUMMARY/TOTALS SECTION, so basis 'none' does not apply: page 4 states A=$0.00, B=$0.00, C=$0.00, D=$0.00, E=$0.00, F=$0.00 and Balance at Close=$0.00, all in the filer's hand with a handwritten '$' (the boxes carry no preprinted dollar sign). Schedule A (p2) and Schedule B (p3) are entirely BLANK of line items, and each prints a handwritten '0.00' on both its 'Subtotal for this page $' and its 'Total Contributions Received $' / 'Total Expenditures Made $' line; the form preprints the '$' on those lines, so the schedule_totals values are recorded without it. The zeros here are ordinary written zeros with a decimal point, not the slashed-O glyph, so they are transcribed at high confidence. This is a zero-activity filing. SCOPE: out_of_scope - the office the filer wrote names a SCHOOL BOARD seat, and the instrument's own title agrees; per the protocol's scope rule the office line decides, and here both point the same way. REPORT-TYPE ANOMALY: TWO marks appear in the 'Mark the applicable report' column - a heavy scribbled-over/struck mark on 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' and a clean filled mark on 'Seven days preceding the General Election'. The struck Primary mark is read as a correction and the General box as the operative one (the report is dated 10/26/24, general-election timing, consistent with that reading); recorded at confidence medium because the correction is inferred from the strike, not printed. NAME NOTE vs THE LEDGER: the ledger's candidate is 'Dennis Jeffery Nielsen' (Jeff-E-ry). The cover's 'Name of Candidate' and the affirmation both read, in rough block capitals, 'DENNIS JEFFREY NIELSEN' (Jeff-R-ey), and pages 2-4 are signed 'D. JEFFREY NIELSEN'; the handwriting is coarse enough that the vowel order is not certain, so candidate_stated is confidence medium. This is a spelling variance in the same person's name, not a different filer - no wrong-candidate-PDF condition. The 'Date of Report' / signature date glyph could be read as 10/26/24 or 10/28/24 (the middle digit is smudged); '24' as the year is consistent with the 2024 cycle and every page carries the same glyph, so 10/26/24 is recorded at medium confidence rather than guessed at high. 'Office Use Only' shows an unfilled 'Logged' circle and the preprinted words 'Web Transmission'; there is no Clerk/Auditor date stamp anywhere.
